EL53.creation_and_use: Instantiate a palette/template item; keep references or create fresh identities explicitly
EL53.stored_content: parameters; defaults; model fragment; view recipe; method/profile version
EL53.completion_rule: Instantiation distinguishes shared references from new objects; no hidden identity duplication
EL53.default_and_example: New identities for copied objects; template Sprint board
EL53.absence: All other semantic payload members absent; no inferred facts.
EL53.render_default_provenance: inferred neutral native card; registered retained role overrides its own glyph, never another method

EL54.name: Namespace
EL54.purpose: A named source/module or platform naming scope
EL54.creation_and_use: Create a module/catalog/schema scope; qualify ambiguous references
EL54.stored_content: scope role; parent; local names; imports/exports
EL54.completion_rule: Namespace identity is distinct from spatial workarea; repeated display names may coexist
EL54.default_and_example: Local names resolved in scope; namespace Sales
EL54.absence: All other semantic payload members absent; no inferred facts.
EL54.render_default_provenance: inferred neutral native card; registered retained role overrides its own glyph, never another method

EL55.name: Association
EL55.purpose: A reified association with named participant roles, including n-ary facts
EL55.creation_and_use: Create an association; add role ports and connect participants; give the association its own fields if needed
EL55.stored_content: association role; participant roles; optional fields/constraints
EL55.completion_rule: Two-plus or incomplete draft participants allowed by profile; n-ary meaning must not be flattened into independent binary links
EL55.default_and_example: Unspecified association; association Supply between supplier part project
EL55.absence: All other semantic payload members absent; no inferred facts.
EL55.render_default_provenance: inferred neutral native card; registered retained role overrides its own glyph, never another method
